section_summary.extract_value: This section reports convergent-incremental validity findings and gender differences in body appreciation using the BAS-2 scale. Negative correlations were found between body appreciation and both social physique anxiety and BMI (rboys = -.20; rgirls = -.25), with boys showing higher body appreciation than girls and underweight/normoweight adolescents showing higher body appreciation than overweight/obese adolescents. Invariance analyses revealed negligible differences in BAS-2 scores when excluding partially invariant items across gender.
